about: What tools/x_plan.mjs rotates and how it spaces things. Numbers marked default are overridden by knowledge/x/cadence.json (the X strategy study) when that file sets them; every override is printed in the plan's notes.

weeklyMix.note: default target share of a week's posts; the planner boosts the family furthest under its share

series.note: default gaps between a series stage and the one before it (min, max); a stage past its max is overdue and jumps the queue. Founder brief: day 1 a close-up, next day the full or the thirds, a week later the animation.

approval: a post whose asset is not founder-accepted goes out as approval.state 'hold' with requireConfirm true; sample days are 'draft'
